# Dns

The DNS resolvers of each interface of the host.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/network/dns/{interface_name}`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node network dns` |
| Jobs | `behavior.dns.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| [netplan](../netplan/netplan.md) | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `debian`, `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`update` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`delete` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

On linux it also runs `resolvectl`.

On darwin it also runs `scutil`.

It writes `/etc/netplan/osapi-dns-*.yaml`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.dns.<method>`, with `behavior.netplan.<method>`, `behavior.managedfile.<method>`, `exec resolvectl`, `exec scutil`, `exec netplan`, `exec chown`, `exec stat`, `file.write`, `file.remove`, `file.chmod`, `kv.get`, `kv.put` under it.

Its span records the input `interface_name` (get, update, delete).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/dns/get.md) | read | `network:read` | Get the DNS resolvers of an interface |
| [`update`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/dns/update.md) | write | `network:write` | Set the DNS resolvers of an interface |
| [`delete`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/dns/delete.md) | write | `network:write` | Drop the DNS resolvers osapi set on an interface |
